Sales ledger control account (trade receivables) and purchases ledger control account (trade payables).
body.front: Name the two main control accounts.

body.back: Helps locate errors; helps detect fraud; provides a total figure for trade receivables or payables quickly; checks the accuracy of the ledger.
body.front: Give two purposes of a control account.

body.back: Opening balance of trade receivables, credit sales, dishonoured cheques, and interest charged on overdue accounts.
body.front: Which items go on the DEBIT side of a sales ledger control account?
body.hint: Things that increase what customers owe

body.back: Cash and cheques received from customers, discounts allowed, sales returns, bad debts written off, and contra entries.
body.front: Which items go on the CREDIT side of a sales ledger control account?
body.hint: Things that reduce what customers owe

body.back: Opening balance of trade payables and credit purchases.
body.front: Which items go on the CREDIT side of a purchases ledger control account?
body.hint: Things that increase what we owe

body.back: Payments made to suppliers, discounts received, purchases returns, and contra entries.
body.front: Which items go on the DEBIT side of a purchases ledger control account?
body.hint: Things that reduce what we owe
